slides.title: Drone strikes hit a grain truck in Tigray
slides.body: Rama town, Central Tigray. AFP, Oct 30, 2026

slides.title: First strike: a vehicle carrying sorghum
slides.body: A private vehicle was hit in the centre of Rama around 9 p.m. on Thursday, Oct 29, AFP reported.

slides.title: killed in a second strike, a resident says
slides.body: On Friday morning, a drone hit people gathering the scattered grain, a resident told AFP.

slides.title: deaths confirmed by a hospital source
slides.body: The medical source said they had heard of two more victims. The army did not respond to AFP. Not independently verified.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Investigate independently.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: AFP via Arab News, Oct 30, 2026 (resident, medical source)
